versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support the development of reliable systems Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall provide mechanisms for error handling in order to support the development of reliable systems. Rationale: Reliability is one of the important characteristics to achieve safety . Use Case: Reduction of repair time of a vehicle in field service.
